failure_class: product defect (skill reload does not persist newly discovered filesystem skills)
observed_output: 1 scenario (1 failed); 7 steps (3 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed)
failure: Owned pack (top-level c40-alpha, nested group/c40-beta, notes/README.md, stray.md) under the owned runtime's relative skills root. POST /api/uar/skills/refresh returned 200 with 422 skills including the new ones. The next GET /api/uar/skills returned 409 'skill_selection_storage_missing; partial outcome possible; read to reconcile'. After removing the pack and refreshing (420 skills), GET returned 200 again.
root_cause_from_source: SkillService::refresh (src/uar/runtime/skills/service.rs:542-563) re-registers provider results with SkillRegistry::register_all_loaded (src/uar/runtime/skills/registry.rs:275), which inserts in memory only. Startup persists changed skills through register_checked_batch_without_embeddings (service.rs:517 → registry.rs:114-126). SkillRegistry::reconcile_selection (registry.rs:130-153) then fails with StorageMissing whenever a registered skill has no durable record, so listing and every selection operation fail after a reload discovers a new skill.
user_impact: Adding a skill to a skills directory and pressing reload makes the whole skill listing fail until the new skill is removed or UAR restarts.
cleanup: pack removed, skills refreshed (listing 200 again), agent deleted; cleanup_errors []
next: Stopped for operator approval of a product fix (persist newly discovered skills during refresh, as startup does), build, owned restart, rerun C40 once.
